svg.text: ESP32-C3 coffee roaster · same pinout & circuit as docs/pinout.svg
teal: SPI bus · dk-teal: chip select (CS)
amber: heat detect · orange: fan 25 kHz · red: SSR 5 Hz
blue: LED · violet: UART · gray: GPIO2 (unused)
red/black: power (3.3 V / GND) · thick: mains
USB CDC (native USB) = alternative to UART
fan chain: 1 kΩ series · 10 kΩ → 3.3 V · 100 kΩ weak pull-down
⚠ GPIO9 strapping pin — 10 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V keeps boot OK · ⚠ GPIO2 = VDD_SPI strap — do not connect anything
⚠ SSR & heater are MAINS — isolate, fuse, disconnect before wiring · 3.3 V logic only on GPIOs (max 3.6 V)
reads LOW when SSR conducts (heater ON)
